description: global_config.patchEdgeConfigItems (PATCH /v1/global-config/{edgeConfigId}/items) models each items[] entry as a oneOf arm carrying a constraint-only inner anyOf (operation/key/value requiredness combinations); the converter's union pass degrades every arm to an `operation`-only struct, so key/value/description never reach PatchEdgeConfigItemsRequest. Strip the inner anyOf so the entry types as the flat object (operation/key/value/description); the per-operation requiredness is enforced server-side (live-verified: upsert+delete batch 200s).
